run_detectron2_training: run the detectron2 plain training loop with a config file and optional resume flag
run_evaluation_only: run evaluation only on a trained detectron2 model using the config and saved weights
create_evaluator: create a dataset evaluator for COCO, LVIS, Cityscapes, or Pascal VOC using get_evaluator
run_inference_on_dataset: run inference on a test dataset using do_test and print CSV format results
setup_detectron2_config: setup and freeze a detectron2 config from a file and command line arguments
